__comment: Hearth - the tavern's social anchor and first heat-bearing furniture piece
(doc 21, doc 34, doc 62 candidate list: 'a tavern hearth = heat source (doc 34)
STATUS (doc 21, 2026-08-03): heat_source.heat_units is DATA ONLY. Doc 34's
room_volume) is not yet implemented in scripts/ - verified no 'RoomData' or heat
accumulation code exists anywhere in the codebase as of this doc. This field is
here so the hearth needs no schema change the day doc 34 lands; nothing reads it
yet. 400 units sits between doc 34's Torch (200) and future Brazier (600) -
a hearth is a bigger, more central heat source than a single torch.
MATERIAL: stone ring with iron grate and glowing embers - a deliberate exception
to the furniture-is-woodwork rule (2026-07-11), same category as the Trade
Counter and workshop bodies: an industrial/utilitarian anchor, and stone is the
only sane material to build an open fire on. Ember glow reuses the smelter/forge
description: A ring of fitted stone with an iron grate, embers glowing at its heart.
